episodeTitle.en: Building beautiful products with Stripe’s Head of Design | Katie Dill (Stripe, Airbnb, Lyft)
episodeTitle.zh: 用Stripe设计总监打造精美产品 | 凯蒂·迪尔（Stripe、Airbnb、Lyft）

guestBioOfficial.en: Katie Dill is the Head of Design at Stripe. Previously, she was Head of Experience Design at Airbnb and Head of Design at Lyft. Katie has been named one of Business Insider’s 10 People Changing the Tech Industry as well as one of Fast Company’s 100 Most Creative People in Business and received the Girls in Tech “Creator of the Year” award. In today’s episode, she shares: • What makes a design great
guestBioOfficial.zh: 凯蒂·迪尔是Stripe的设计总监。此前，她曾担任Airbnb的体验设计主管和Lyft的设计主管。凯蒂被《商业内幕》评选为"改变科技行业的10位人物"之一，入选《快公司》"商业界最具创造力100人"榜单，并获得Girls in Tech"年度创始人"奖项。在本期节目中，她将分享：• 何为伟大的设计

title.en: Building beautiful products with Stripe’s Head of Design | Katie Dill (Stripe, Airbnb, Lyft)
title.zh: 用Stripe设计总监打造精美产品 | 凯蒂·迪尔（Stripe、Airbnb、Lyft）

summary.en: Katie makes the case that beauty and functionality are not opposites - beautiful design actually improves usability, trust, and approachability. She traces how the word "beauty" faded from digitized books as functionality became king, and why that mindset is mistaken. The episode shows how investing in craft pays off in user trust and business results.
summary.zh: 凯蒂指出，美与功能并非对立——美观的设计实际上能提升可用性、信任感与亲和力。她追溯了随着"功能为王"观念的盛行，"美"一词如何从数字化书籍中消退，并说明这种想法是错误的。本期展示了在设计工艺上的投入如何转化为用户信任与商业成果。
